summary: Shows updating a module argument in the debugger (task.args['name'] = 'bash') to fix an invalid package name, then redo.
questions: How do I fix a wrong package name during a playbook run?
Do I need to run redo after changing task.args?

answer_card.title: Updating module args in the debugger
answer_card.answer_md:
```
(debug)> p task.args
{u'name': u'{{ pkg_name }}'}
(debug)> task.args['name'] = 'bash'
(debug)> redo
```

After changing args, `redo` runs the task again with them.
